prerequisites: No prerequisites. Competencies taught in the basic modules for Practical Informatics are recommended.

learning_outcomes.text: have basic knowledge and skills in process management
know the theoretical principles of process management as well as selected applications
are able to apply working methods from business informatics
are able to speak freely about scientific content, both in front of an audience and in a discussion

assessment_methods.method: Written exam or oral examination (individual examination)

assessment_rules: To acquire credit points, at least 50 percent of the points from the weekly exercise assignments must be achieved. Grading is done on a scale of 0 to 15 points according to the examination regulations for the B.Sc. Business Informatics degree program.
